description: §15.11.4 (S459 round 6, F4) — calling an OPTIONAL function-typed prop with no absence check is E-TYPE-031, in every call form: the bare event-attribute call (`onclick=onGo()`), an expression lambda (`${() => onGo()}`), and a block arrow (`${() => { onGo() }}`). It is a property of the definition (the prop is `fn | not` in the body), so it fires even where every caller passes the prop, once per component (Blk has two instances, one error). Before round 6 an omitted prop emitted `null()` silently.
rationale: §15.11.4: "an unguarded call to a potentially-absent function-typed prop SHALL be a compile error (E-TYPE-031: cannot call a value of type `fn | not` without an absence check)."
